items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Oh, Wendell played with all of them.

ctx.x: Oh, Wendell played with all of them. He played with all, at different times with all of them. Wendell did. See these fellas, getting out his daddy. In those days, all of them played around with each other. See? Even though you have a band tonight. Now this is your band tonight. Now next week you're in somebody else's band. See, because bands broke up just that fast. The bosses let you out just that fast. They didn't have to notify you. He let you out. They let you out. They wouldn't let you out. They split the…
Now what about these piano players? Say like Buddy Gurns. Would he have a steady job?
